context_requirements: Mutant BRAF (V600E) or oncogenic RAS/MAPK pathway activation for strong single-agent sensitivity
Dependence on RAF/MEK/ERK signaling for proliferation and survival
Wild-type or functional TP53/RB for robust cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis programs
Expression of RAF isoforms and/or KDR (VEGFR2) for direct target engagement
falsifiers: No decrease in MAPK output genes (e.g., DUSP6, SPRY2, SPRY4, ETV4, ETV5) at 6 h in BRAF-mutant lines such as A375 or HT29
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
Strong and selective upregulation of MAPK target genes at 6 h, indicating paradoxical pathway activation rather than inhibition
Equivalent transcriptional responses in BRAF-mutant and BRAF-wild-type lines, arguing against on-target RAF inhibition
